_comment: Reusable blocks on book.html: the reader review and the author bio. Rendered by build.js into the ep:bk-review and ep:bk-author regions. Edit here or in Site Studio. Paragraphs are arrays, so adding one is adding a line.

review.label: The first review the book got, unedited
review.headline: Must-read if you’re looking to enhance your output.
paragraphs: “What an amazing read! I would highly recommend The Artificial Advantage if you’re looking to master AI. It gives you a very clear framework that will assist you in your professional and personal life.
Elvin Peters does an amazing job ensuring that these concepts are easily digestible! I’ll be recommending this to all of my coworkers who have been struggling with AI and prompting.”

author.label: About the Author
author.name: Elvin M. Peters
author.title: Author · Marketing Strategist · A decade in performance marketing
paragraphs: I spent three years inside Google Ads, watching brilliant people get mediocre results from AI, and I figured out exactly why. After that I led digital marketing at one of Canada's largest fintechs, running AI-integrated campaigns across Google, Meta, and Quora at scale. I have been testing and directing AI tools since ChatGPT launched in 2022.

I wrote The Artificial Advantage because I watched too many capable professionals underuse tools that could have transformed how they worked. Not because the tools weren't powerful, but because nobody gave them a framework for directing them.
The Artificial Advantage is Volume 1 of the AI Fluency Series. Volume 2, The Systematic Advantage, is in progress.
